title: Neighbour activation with typed paths and the construction guard: a replacement for the single branch distance (Q5, Q2b)
summary: I tested this by script on independent labels. Quran-slm's similarity is still the best way to choose between branches once the partner branch is known. On 12,000 v12 cases where the partner branch is given, NeoAraBERT scores MRR 0.521 on non-B001 targets. That compares with 0.337 for an exact random order (Phase 1's "random 0.145" understated the baseline). No learned combination beats it: surah-grouped 5-fold CV gives 0.503, and the learning curve is flat from 10% of the labels. Similarity is still the wrong tool for the harvest. That task is neighbour activation (NA): given only the ayah's words, which rare branch of each word lights up, through what, and is that sense allowed there. On the same independent v12 data, rebuilt as NA cases (3,053 latent targets), two orderings do better than similarity: (a) a floor-gated fusion of typed path scores and (b) a "convergence" count, i.e. how many independent path types tie a branch to one neighbouring word. Latent-branch MRR is 0.594–0.606 against 0.558 for Neo, and recall@3 is 0.72–0.73 against 0.685. Both apply the dictionary's own construction guard. Every candidate carries a path in words. On the 29:38 watch case the harvest puts the sabal eye film first of the 8 س ب ل branches with two explicit paths. One is "Quran pairs «غشاوة» with مستبصرين (2:7, 45:23)". The other is "names «العنكبوت» = 29:41, the only ayah with that word"; the IDF cross-reference ranks 29:41 first of 6,235 ayat. The guard is a real, measurable fix, not a formality. 19.6% of slm's top-1 branch pairs for same-ayah words, and 18.8% of v15-style scene links, rest on a collocation-bound branch whose construction is absent. ḍaraba at 4:34 gets 40 travel-scene partners only through B002. Independent readers' rejects carry 2.7× more such branches (16.4% vs 6.1% of pairs). The guard also collides with 8 gold items the user valued: 5 S1 anchors, including mālik as lead animal, and 3 ع م ل links in 29:38. So I recommend it as a labelled "echo only" tier that is never stated as the word's sense, and I leave the strict filter to the user. Within the ayah, NA does not reach S1's surah-level coalitions: the median relative rank of S1 anchors is 0.33. Those need the surah step built on the existing chains.

stages.name: S0 build indices (once)
stages.input: quran-slm catalog/cards/rank maps/embeddings and s1_ar3_v1 clause embeddings; dictionary tr/*_entry.json (branch_kind, neighbor_distinctions, occurrence_evidence alignments); furuq_v4.sqlite lexical_unit_senses (collocation expressions); v15 words/lemmas/frames; QAC via v15 words.tsv
stages.output: cache/*.pkl: card→lemma mentions, lemma/root ayah sets, random-pair floors (90th/95th/99th percentiles), construction signatures for 1,564 of 1,641 collocation branches, status for all 66,187 occurrence × collocation-branch pairs
stages.size_or_tokens: about 1 min total; guard pass 4–5 s

stages.name: S1 per-ayah NA harvest
stages.input: focus ayah, ±3 window, guard statuses, 8 path types
stages.output: NNN_AAA.push.md: per word, every live branch in NA order; the top 3 plus pointer-grade or ≥5-kind branches carry up to 3 paths (activator word, type, witness ayat); an 'echo only' line lists construction-absent collocation branches with their phrase; same-surah definitional pointers; a construction-grouped concordance for roots in ≤40 ayat. NNN_AAA.pull.json: every (word, branch) with every type's best value, activator branch and word, and guard status
stages.size_or_tokens: push 1.4k–65k chars ≈ 0.6k–30k tokens (13 sample ayat: 1:3 630 tokens, 1:6 2.4k, 29:38 6.9k, 18:96 10.4k, 18:86 11.7k, 4:34 16.6k, 5:6 29.7k); pull 4–176 KB; 5–15 s per ayah on a laptop
stages.stance: order only, never filter; no verdicts

stages.name: S2 per-surah coalition candidates (M8)
stages.input: S1 pull tables of all ayat in the surah; the existing chains (channel reviews/HFT) as seeds
stages.output: for each existing chain, the surah branches the typed union adds under set-conditioned growth, each with its paths, handed to the surah step as grounding/extension candidates (never a rediscovery pass)
stages.size_or_tokens: not built end to end; tested only on S1 gold coalitions

stages.name: S3 synthesis
stages.who: Opus 5.5 effort high (not designed here; reads the push, pulls on demand)
stages.input: core context + push.md (+ permission to use memory, marked)

stages.name: S4 post-synthesis construction check
stages.input: prose Arabic tags / claimed senses mapped to branches; guard statuses
stages.output: flags: a collocation-bound sense stated as the word's sense where its construction is absent; a memory sense matching no branch (marked); a construction-absent echo used without its phrase
stages.stance: verification, not pruning; flags go to the writer/editor

data_processing.source: quran-data dictionary/tr branch_kind + occurrence_evidence grammar alignments; dictionary furuq_v4.sqlite lexical_unit_senses (unit_kind=collocation); card source phrases
data_processing.method: derive a signature (preposition + partner root/lemma) from each collocation expression and from 'root-form + prep + noun' in the classical phrases; at each occurrence, match the aligned attachments (strict) or a ±4-word window (weak)
data_processing.coverage: 1,641 catalog collocation branches, 1,564 with signatures; 66,187 occurrence statuses: absent 59,557, strict 531, window 601, prep-only 324, unknown 5,174
data_processing.cost: script, 5 s. My hand check (guard_sample.log): strict 26/30 correct, window 6/15, absent 25/25 random plus 30/30 of the 'partner root elsewhere in the ayah' risky subset (guard_sample2.log)

data_processing.method: tokens that map to exactly one Quranic lemma (least-stripped spelling first; lemmas in >300 ayat skipped); -log10 binomial tail of co-occurring with the neighbour root; witness ayat kept
card names a Quranic lexeme of another root; weight = log(#ayat / #ayat with that root)
data_processing.coverage: 80,443 root mentions; 53,061 after the df>400 stoplist

data_processing.method: occurrences of the root grouped by lemma × (relation, preposition, partner root)
data_processing.coverage: any root; pushed for roots in ≤40 ayat

data_processing.source: v15 Luna frames/out (existing, no new runs)
data_processing.method: shared concrete scene with a different role, IDF-weighted; added scene ids merged by prefix

data_processing.source: quran-slm artifacts/s1_ar3_v1/embeddings (E5 clause and source-unit vectors, mapped back by clause_map.py)
data_processing.method: max cosine over centred clause vectors
data_processing.cost: local, existing vectors (no encoder run possible: no torch)

avoids_known_failures.failure: construction-to-root drift (ḍaraba = travel; Lisān-style folding), also in model memory
avoids_known_failures.mechanism: the dictionary's branch_kind is applied at every occurrence. A construction-absent collocation branch cannot activate others, is ordered after all live branches, and appears only on an 'echo only' line with its phrase. At 4:34 B002/B003/B004/B005/B011 are echo-only; at 3:156, 4:94, 4:101, 5:106 and 73:20, B002 is present. S4 flags prose that states such a sense as the word's sense. No late lexicon is read.

avoids_known_failures.failure: readings lost between stages; selector hides what it left out (v14 composition dropped the eye film)
avoids_known_failures.mechanism: the push lists every live branch of every word in order (paths for the top ones), plus the echo line; the pull holds every score. 29:38: all 16 gold link branches are visible in the push (7 with paths, 6 listed, 3 echo-only).

avoids_known_failures.failure: similarity finds near-synonyms, not scene parts
avoids_known_failures.mechanism: similarity is one path type among 8. Scene complement, lexical bridge and cross-reference reach partners similarity ranks far (29:41 is ayah rank 1 by xref_idf vs 737 by bridge_dir and 581.5 by shared mention).

avoids_known_failures.failure: bulk push dilutes synthesis / 2 MB packets
avoids_known_failures.mechanism: push median ≈ 7k tokens on the 13 sample ayat (maximum 30k for 5:6), an order of magnitude below the 150k-token range where Phase 1 saw thinking collapse; the rest is a pull away

avoids_known_failures.failure: verdict-carrying inputs and labels used as filters
avoids_known_failures.mechanism: no grades or plausibility in the push: counts, paths and witness ayat only; the guard is a label and an order

avoids_known_failures.failure: architecture cannot see the partner in another ayah (v11: 7 of 9 S1 misses)
avoids_known_failures.mechanism: ±3 window activators plus same-surah definitional pointers; the S2 surah coalition step is designed for the rest
nothing case-specific in scripts or push; watch cases used only as evaluation. The convergence rule was motivated by 29:38 during design but validated on independent v12 NA cases (+0.036 MRR).

watch_cases.case: 29:38 sabal eye film activated by neighbours
watch_cases.how_produced: harvest2.py and conv_eval/gold2 NA ranking of س ب ل B010 among the 8 س ب ل branches and the 74 non-primary branches of the ayah
watch_cases.result: Ayah words only: ranks 3/8 by Neo (21/74), by the lemma bridge (20/74; path غشاوة in 2:7, 45:23 ← mustabṣirīn), by convergence (18/74; 4 kinds ← mustabṣirīn); scene complement 4/8 (body.eye ← mustabṣirīn). ±3 window: 1/8 by xref_idf, RRF union and convergence (1/74, 8/74, 5/74). In the final push it is the first سبيل line and carries 'in the ayah, 4 kinds: Quran pairs «غشاوه» with مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ (2:7, 45:23)' and 'names «العنكبوت» = 29:41 (1 ayat)'. Spider link: 29:41 is rank 1 of 6,235 ayat by xref_idf. Kohl (ص د د B013) is 3rd of 12 in فصدهم, '4 kinds ← مستبصرين'. Not found by any metric: zayyana (coating) ↔ eye film.

watch_cases.how_produced: gold2.py T4 (branch choice given the target word/ayah)
watch_cases.result: MRR: union_floor 0.782, union_rrf 0.772, slm_fused 0.763, Neo 0.752, random 0.348. 3 links (ع م ل B010/B011/B012 'trodden road', 'working limb', 'foot travellers') are collocation-bound with construction absent (طريق معمل, عوامل الدابة, بنو العمل): echo tier.

watch_cases.case: Fatiha chains (S1 gold ledger; in-sample for slm, v15 inventory contaminated)
watch_cases.how_produced: gold2.py T3; conv_eval S1 anchors; push_recall.py
watch_cases.result: Pairs found in the top 10 of about 130 other-root S1 branches, out of 62: slm_fused 33, union_floor 35, union_min 48. union_min reads about 34 candidates, and slm at 34 also gets 47, so there is no gain at equal size. Contrasts G014/G015 were found by nothing (dict_contrast 0). Push carries 37 of 47 anchors with paths, 6 listed, 4 echo-only. Within their own ayah, anchors reach only median relative rank 0.333 (convergence) vs 0.353 (Neo): S1's chains are surah-level. M8 growth with the union: road spine 21→26/30, water 9→14/30.

'ك ع ب (4 ayat): كعبة ×2: 5:95, 5:97; كعبين 5:6; كواعب 78:33' and 'ر ف ق: مرتفق ×2: 18:29, 18:31 … مرافق [after إلى] 5:6'. Same-root recurrence, which the branch distance excludes by design, is supplied here.

S1 G007/G026 (م ل ك B008 lead animal: 'مَلِيك النحل; مَلَك الدابة'), G023 (م ل ك B007), G019/G020 (ن ع م B011/B012), 29:38 ع م ل B010–B012, and the dictionary arm's 'water that stands' (ق و م B016 'قام الماء' at 1:6) all fall in the echo tier. A strict filter would remove them.

cost.per_ayah_test_cli: Harvest $0. The push adds 0.6k–30k input tokens (median ≈7k on 13 sample ayat) to one Opus call: about $0.005–0.24, typically $0.06, at the $8/M 'claude -p' input rate recorded in Phase 1 §4.7.
cost.per_ayah_production_api: About $0.001–0.06, typically $0.014, for the push through Batch, assuming about $2/M Batch input (Phase 1's $8/M is a 2× cache write, so base is about $4/M, halved by Batch). The synthesis call itself is costed elsewhere.
cost.one_time: Scripts only, no model runs. Index and guard build: about 1 min. Whole-Quran harvest: estimated 9–26 CPU-hours at the measured 5–15 s per ayah, about 1.5–3 h on 8 cores (Inference). Optional cleanup of the v15 scene inventory: 0 runs proposed.
cost.assumptions: Token count ≈ chars/2.2 for Arabic-heavy text (Inference, not measured with a tokenizer). Prices are taken from Phase 1's recorded figures, not quoted from a price list. No Luna runs are needed.

experiments_run.method: My key directory already held an interrupted earlier attempt. Its common.py source had been overwritten, so I rebuilt it from the compiled module (old/dis_common.txt), kept the old logs in old/, and recomputed every number reported here with readable scripts.
experiments_run.result: The cards, dictionary, words and tags caches are byte-identical to the earlier run. The lexicon was made stricter (least-stripped match, pronoun stoplist).

validation_plan.step: V1 guard audit by the user: 60 sampled decisions (20 strict, 20 window, 20 absent) plus a ruling on the 8 conflicting gold items (strict filter vs echo tier)
validation_plan.success_criterion: strict precision ≥85% and absent precision ≥95% confirmed; the tier rule is fixed before any model run

validation_plan.step: V2 freeze the metric set and ordering (convergence vs union_floor), then rerun T6 on the 11 reserved and 8 validation surahs only, with no changes allowed afterwards
validation_plan.success_criterion: latent MRR above Neo by ≥0.02 on the held-out surahs

validation_plan.step: V3 Opus A/B, 6 ayat (29:38, 18:86, 18:96, 4:34, 100:1, one unseen ayah), arm A = the Phase 1 brief with memory permission, arm B = the same brief plus the push; 2 replicates each; I score blind to arm
validation_plan.model_runs: 24 Opus (effort high) calls via claude -p; needs the user's approval
validation_plan.success_criterion: arm B surfaces more supported rare branches with their activating word (eye film + 29:41 in both B replicates), ≥0 construction-drift flags from S4, no rise in catalogue length
validation_plan.cost: ≈$12–20 at the Phase 1 cold-arm median $0.44 per call + push $0.03–0.24

validation_plan.step: V4 surah step: typed-union M8 on existing chains for 2 surahs, compared with the chain reviews
validation_plan.model_runs: none for the candidates; any surah synthesis is a separate approval
validation_plan.success_criterion: adds grounded members to ≥50% of existing chains without inventing new chains

risks.risk: The guard's weak detection: a ±4-word 'window' match is right only 6/15 times; 'unknown' covers 5,174 statuses
risks.mitigation: only 'strict' counts as present; window/prep-only are labelled 'construction?' and stay live; unknown stays live and is flagged

risks.risk: The strict dictionary principle removes readings the user valued (8 gold items)
risks.mitigation: the echo tier keeps them visible as phrase echoes and never as the word's sense; the user decides (open question 1)

risks.risk: Lexical-path noise from generic lemmas (الشيء, الناس, بينهما) and frequent activator roots
risks.mitigation: floors, lemma df≤300, activator root df≤400 for the bridge; lowering lemma df to 150 (v9's value) is untested

risks.risk: Label bias: v12 readers are LLMs with a primary-sense bias; the 29:38 watch case shaped the convergence idea
risks.mitigation: evaluation on non-B001 targets among latent branches only; the convergence gain was measured on 3,053 independent cases; freeze before the held-out rerun (V2)

risks.risk: Push length for long ayat (5:6 ≈30k tokens)
risks.mitigation: push 'then:' lines as branch IDs only for ayat over about 20k tokens, with everything a pull away; still an order of magnitude below the collapse range

risks.risk: v15 scene tags are contaminated (the inventory knew the North Star examples) and noisy
risks.mitigation: scene is one of 8 types and never decisive alone; S1 results are reported as in-sample

reuse: quran-slm rank maps + embeddings (artifacts/corpus_network, corpus_ensemble) and the July E5 clause vectors (artifacts/s1_ar3_v1/embeddings)

open_questions: Dictionary principle in practice: is a construction-absent collocation branch (mālik as lead animal, the trodden road in aʿmālahum, the standing water in al-mustaqīm) forbidden, or allowed as a marked phrase echo that is never stated as the word's sense? 8 gold items depend on the answer.
Push shape for long ayat: every branch listed in order (current design) or only the top slice plus pointers?

Contrasts (standing ↔ vanishing, soft ↔ hard) are reached by no local signal, the dictionary's polarity relations included. Is a contrast source wanted (for example al-ʿAskarī's Furūq as a secondary aid)?
Should the zayyana ↔ eye film link be left to synthesis? No card text supports it.
Should the torch environment be repaired (the quran-slm .venv interpreter is missing) so a cross-encoder can be tested? This is the only untested learned option.
